q: Ek switch kaun si OSI layer par kaam karta hai?
explain: Switch L2 Data Link device hai; ye MAC address dekh ke frame sahi port par bhejta hai.

q: Full mesh topology mein 6 nodes ke liye kitne links chahiye?
Frame 1000 bytes, link 1 Mbps. Transmission delay kitna hai?
explain: 1000 bytes = 8000 bits; 8000 / 1,000,000 = 8 ms. Transmission delay = size / bandwidth.

q: Hub ke baare mein kaun sa sahi hai?
options: Poore network mein ek hi collision domain
IP address dekh ke forward karta hai
explain: Hub L1 device hai; sab ports ek hi collision domain mein hote hain aur data sab ports par jaata hai.

q: Walkie-talkie kaun se transmission mode ka example hai?
explain: Walkie-talkie half-duplex hai: dono taraf baat ho sakti hai par ek samay sirf ek aadmi.
